dublinCore.description: Interactive timeline of 23 AI milestones from 1956 to 2025. Stems are colored by era, hover shows each milestone, and a slider bends the time axis from linear to one that expands recent years.
relation: Chapter 15: Signal Processing Applications and AI Integration

learningObjectives: Identify the era of a milestone from the color of its stem and the legend
Compare how many milestones the plotted list contains in each era
Predict how a larger exponent p moves each milestone along the time axis
Evaluate whether a hand-picked event list is enough evidence that AI progress is accelerating

misconceptions.misconception: A taller stem means a more important or more capable system
misconceptions.correction: Stem height only grows with the year and is nudged up so neighboring names do not collide; the data are the year, the name and the description
misconceptions.evidence: Move the slider: the stems keep their order and height pattern while only the horizontal positions change

misconceptions.misconception: A count of listed events shows how fast AI improved
misconceptions.correction: The list is one author's selection and many recent entries are product releases; a count of events is not a measure of capability
misconceptions.evidence: Compare the slider at 0 and at 100: the visual clustering depends on the axis mapping

accessibility.screenReaderScript: Timeline of 23 AI milestones from 1956 to 2025. Stems are colored by era: 5 before 2000, 5 from 2000 to 2014, 6 from 2015 to 2022 and 7 from 2023 on. A slider changes the time axis from linear to one that expands the recent years. Hovering over a milestone shows its description.

controls.label: Time-axis scale
controls.description: Sets the exponent p = 1 + 2.5 x value / 100 in the position ((year - 1956) / 69)^p; 0 is a linear axis and 100 expands the recent years the most

visualElements.description: Time axis from 1956 to 2025 with one stem and circle per milestone, a slanted name label and a legend that counts the events in each era
Information box with the name, year and description of the hovered milestone

model.description: Maps each year to a horizontal position with a power law of the elapsed time and stacks the stem heights so neighboring labels do not overlap

instructionalStrategies: Predict-then-verify the movement of one event when the axis changes
Compare event counts per era before drawing a conclusion
extensions: Add a second, objectively measured series to the same axis
Add the events of a subfield such as speech recognition
